privacyReport.title: Verified Privacy
privacyReport.description: No data leaves your browser. Processing occurs entirely on your device using Web Crypto API, WebAssembly, and other cutting-edge modern technologies.

howItWorks.title: How it works?
howItWorks.background-remover: Uses the 'RMBG' AI model running locally in your browser via the ONNX Runtime Web library. Image processing happens on your CPU/GPU without sending anything to external servers.
howItWorks.file-decompressor: Uses JSZip and js-untar libraries to read the binary structure of compressed files directly in the browser's memory, allowing individual file extraction.
howItWorks.media-compressor: Employs FFmpeg compiled for WebAssembly (WASM). This brings the power of the world's most used video processing tool inside your browser.
howItWorks.file-encryptor: Uses the browser's native Web Crypto API with the 256-bit AES-GCM algorithm. The password is derived using PBKDF2 with 100,000 iterations of SHA-256.
howItWorks.hash-generator: Makes use of the 'subtle.digest' function of the Web Crypto API to calculate the SHA-256 hash of texts or files instantly and securely.
howItWorks.file-compressor: Uses the JSZip library to create a new compressed file in memory, packaging the selected files with the maximum level of DEFLATE compression.
howItWorks.word-counter: Applies regular expressions and JavaScript string processing logic to analyze the text and calculate detailed statistics in real-time.
howItWorks.file-converter: Combines Canvas API for images and PDF.js for documents, allowing conversion of visual formats without depending on cloud processing.
howItWorks.image-resizer: Uses the browser's Canvas API to redraw the image at the specified new dimensions, applying interpolation algorithms to maintain quality.
howItWorks.json-formatter: Uses native JSON.parse and JSON.stringify methods with custom indentation to validate and organize JSON data structures instantly.
howItWorks.qr-generator: Employs dot matrix generation algorithms to convert strings into visual QR Code patterns, rendering the result on a canvas for download.
howItWorks.exif-extractor: Uses the exifr library to read image binary buffers and extract hidden metadata like GPS coordinates, camera model, and exposure settings.

faq.a1: Yes, it's 100% safe. All files and data are processed locally in your browser. Nothing is sent to our servers.
faq.q2: Do I need to pay to use it?
faq.a2: No, all tools are free and ad-free. The project is maintained by community donations.
faq.a3: Yes! Thanks to PWA technology, after the first access, most tools work even without an internet connection.

background-remover.title: Free Online Image Background Remover - 100% Automatic
background-remover.description: Remove background from photos instantly with AI. High quality, free, and no registration required. Processing is done 100% in your browser.
features: Total privacy: photos don't leave your PC

faq.a: Yes, SLIT.IO offers completely free and unlimited background removal, with no hidden fees or watermarks.

faq.q: Are my photos sent to any server?
faq.a: No. Unlike other sites, our AI runs directly in your browser. Your images never leave your device.

faq.q: Is there an image size limit?
faq.a: We don't impose strict limits, but performance depends on your hardware since processing is local.

file-decompressor.title: Free Online ZIP and TAR File Extractor
file-decompressor.description: Extract ZIP and TAR files directly in your browser securely. Unzip files online without software installation, ensuring 100% privacy.

faq.a: Yes, as long as your browser has available memory. SLIT.IO processes everything locally, so there are no upload limits.

faq.q: Does the site support password-protected files?
faq.a: Currently we support standard ZIP and TAR extraction. Password support is on our roadmap.

media-compressor.title: Online Video and Image Compressor - No Quality Loss
media-compressor.description: Reduce the size of MP4 videos and PNG/JPG/WEBP images while maintaining high quality. Free online media compressor focused on privacy.
features: Support for MP4, WebM, PNG, JPG, and WEBP

faq.a: You have full control over the quality level. Our tool seeks the best balance between size and clarity.
It depends on your device's processing power, as we use local hardware to ensure your privacy.

file-encryptor.title: Secure AES-256 File Encryption Online
file-encryptor.description: Protect your files with AES-256 bit encryption directly in the browser. Encrypt and decrypt files locally with a password safely.
features: Local processing via Web Crypto API

faq.a: Never. Your password and files never leave your computer. If you forget your password, we cannot recover your data.

faq.q: Is it safe for sensitive files?
faq.a: Yes, because you don't 'send' anything. Encryption happens in your browser. It's like using local software, but without installing anything.

hash-generator.title: Secure Online SHA-256 Hash Generator
hash-generator.description: Generate SHA-256 hashes for any text or file. Verify file integrity online for free with 100% local processing.
features: Instant hashes for text and files
Total privacy via Web Crypto API

faq.a: It is a unique digital signature for your data. If a single bit changes in the file, the hash will be completely different.

faq.q: Can I generate hashes for large files?
faq.a: Yes, our tool processes files in blocks locally, allowing you to verify files of several GB safely.

file-compressor.title: Free Online ZIP File Compressor
file-compressor.description: Create ZIP files from multiple files easily and securely. Compress files online without sending your data to the cloud.
features: No limits on the number of files

faq.q: Is there a file limit for ZIP?
faq.a: We do not impose limits. The only limit is your device's memory and processing capacity.

word-counter.title: Free Online Word and Character Counter
word-counter.description: Count words, characters, sentences, and paragraphs in real-time. Analyze reading and speaking time for your text for free.

faq.a: No. All text processing occurs in your browser's memory and is discarded as soon as you close the page.

file-converter.title: Free Online File Converter - Image, PDF, and JSON

features: Convert between image formats (PNG, JPG, WEBP)
JSON to CSV converter and vice versa
Local processing via Canvas and PDF.js

faq.q: Can I convert PDF to Word?
faq.a: Currently, we focus on visual and data conversions. More formats coming soon!

image-resizer.title: Free Online Image Resizer

features: Guaranteed privacy: photos don't leave your PC

faq.q: Does the image lose quality when resizing?
faq.a: We use browser interpolation algorithms to ensure the image remains sharp at new dimensions.

faq.q: Is it safe to paste production data here?

faq.a: Yes. Passwords are generated using crypto.getRandomValues(), which uses the operating system's cryptographic random source.

faq.a: Base64 is a encoding scheme that represents binary data as ASCII text, commonly used for embedding data in URLs and emails.

timestamp-converter.title: Free Online Unix Timestamp Converter

faq.a: camelCase is a naming convention where each word begins with a capital letter except the first word, like 'myVariableName'.

markdown-preview.description: Write Markdown on the left, see the rendered preview on the right. Supports headings, bold, italic, code, links, and lists. All in your browser.

privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.intro: SLIT.IO is built on a foundation of privacy. This policy explains how we handle your data — or more precisely, how we don't.
privacyPage.section1: SLIT.IO does not collect, store, or transmit any personal data. All tools process files and text entirely within your browser using client-side JavaScript and WebAssembly. No data ever leaves your device.
privacyPage.section2: When you use any tool on SLIT.IO — whether compressing an image, encrypting a file, counting words, or removing a background — the processing happens 100% locally in your web browser. Your files are never uploaded to any server.
privacyPage.section3: We use Vercel Web Analytics and Speed Insights, which collect anonymous, aggregated page-view and performance metrics (such as page load time). This data is non-personal and cannot be used to identify individual users. No cookies are set for analytics purposes.
privacyPage.section4: SLIT.IO uses only a single local storage entry to remember your theme preference (light/dark mode). No tracking cookies are used.
privacyPage.section5: Some tools download processing models (such as ONNX models for background removal) from third-party CDNs. These downloads are anonymous — no personal information is sent. No other third-party services have access to your data.
privacyPage.section6: If you have questions about this privacy policy, you can reach us through the feedback form.

aboutPage.openSource: SLIT.IO is open source. You can view the code, report issues, or contribute on GitHub.
